# HIR_Roadmap

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The IEEE Heterogeneous Integration Roadmap (HIR) is a strategic framework outlining technology trends and challenges for 3D integration, advanced packaging, and interconnect scaling. Provides the physical-layer constraints and scaling targets that determine how TCC topologies can be mapped onto real chiplet and package architectures.
